adversarial.summary: AI review unavailable; deterministic council remains valid.

evidence_against: No scientific learning claim is established: all 28 registry candidates marked MATURED_INCONCLUSIVE have zero scientific-score-eligible outcomes, despite some having many matured outcomes. The shadow registry lists no promotion candidates.

The same W39–W43 driver sets recur across assets and horizons. The protection calibration explicitly warns that overlapping freezes are not independent events; independent adverse-event counts are null.

Rebounds, positive BTC ETF flows during W43, and positive short-horizon terminal returns in some cohorts challenge a one-sided or uninterrupted-downside interpretation. No supplied artifact confirms distribution.

The 30-day rotation label reached ALTCOIN_SEASON in W40 while the 90-day and 365-day readings were 55 and 37, ETH/BTC declined, and ETH ETF flows were negative. The short-window label alone does not establish broad transmission.
evidence_for: An evidence-milestone review is supported by the supplied eligibility markers: 39 newly matured outcomes exceed the stated minimum of 25; the monthly review is not due and no escalation is triggered.
The architecture dashboard reports 272 matured and adjudicated outcomes in its 14-day window, with zero censored outcomes. This supports an outcome-accountability review, not a skill finding.

The protection calibration contains 1,240 eligible series rows, including 1,028 warning rows. Its W42–W43 elevated-retest cohorts show negative median terminal returns at 72h and 168h for both BTC and ETH, descriptively.

Rows without a frozen typed warning also show substantial observed 168h maximum adverse excursions: median −4.72% for BTC and −10.20% for ETH, each across 20 distinct Compass freezes. These are observations, not established missed-warning events.

Weekly adjudication labels 346 of 670 reviewed candidates ARCHIVE_ONLY_DUPLICATE and 288 WAIT_FOR_MORE_PROSPECTIVE_EVIDENCE. This identifies redundancy and an evidence gap without treating either as learned market behavior.
hypotheses: New, preregistered research test: At the independent, non-overlapping episode level, frozen typed protection states discriminate subsequent 72h BTC and ETH maximum adverse excursion better than a prespecified comparable no-typed-warning baseline, without obscuring subsequent upside. Falsified if the out-of-sample episode-level comparison shows no incremental discrimination or an offsetting upside cost. Existing tests must remain unchanged.

New, preregistered research test: ETH/BTC weakness adds information about subsequent ETH-relative downside when BTC and ETH settled ETF flows diverge, beyond the frozen comparison inputs. Falsified if an out-of-sample, non-overlapping episode comparison finds no incremental ETH-relative discrimination. The supplied W43 divergence is motivation, not validation.
analyst.summary: The milestone permits a research review, but not a scientific learning claim. The clearest finding is descriptive outcome accountability alongside unresolved discrimination: warning cohorts experienced downside at longer horizons, yet substantial adverse excursions also occurred without typed warnings, while rebounds and upside complicate a one-sided reading. The highest-information bounded question is whether frozen protection states add out-of-sample, episode-level 72h downside discrimination over a comparable no-warning baseline while accounting for upside. Distribution, timing, exit and re-entry rules remain unlearned.
uncertainties: The 39-outcome maturation delta is not identified as 39 independent events or 39 scientific-score-eligible outcomes.
Independent adverse-event counts are null; overlapping freezes and repeated asset/horizon rows preclude treating row counts as independent sample sizes.
The no-typed-warning adverse excursions do not establish false negatives without an eligible event definition and comparable baseline.

The registry has 691 candidates and 28 matured-inconclusive candidates, whereas the weekly adjudication covers 670 and assigns 27 KEEP_SHADOW_INCONCLUSIVE; these are different reported scopes, not reconciled counts.

Architecture health is GREEN only within its evidence scope; automation health is AMBER, including schedule-staleness findings and four created hourly schedule events against 24 expected slots on 2026-11-04. Aggregate system health is not asserted.
